=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_skip_ai_marker_rule.py:159 (cause at scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:774) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The clean_same_head skip adds a fourth `GATE_SKIP_RECORDED="true"` site, but the contract test still asserts `script.count('GATE_SKIP_RECORDED="true"') == 3`, and its comment (lines 156-158) still lists only three sites.
  WHY: CI job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails with `FAILED tests/test_skip_ai_marker_rule.py::test_every_skip_is_logged_before_the_outputs - assert 4 == 3`. The new assignment must stay, because removing it would log a duplicate `AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP` line. The fix is to change the assertion to `== 4` and update the comment. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:357, 584-600, 628-645 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The clean same-head block ignores single-issue security-pass follow-ups. The fetch jq at line 357 does not keep `<!-- ai:single-issue-security-pass:v1 ` bodies, FAILURE_TOKENS has no security-pass token, and no precondition exempts the re-dispatch from scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:680, which passes only `pr_number`.
  WHY: "Post editor summary comment" (review_autofix.yml line 3917) writes the clean marker before "Single-issue security pass" (line 4355) runs. The re-dispatch after a clean or failed audit is then skipped as clean_same_head, and codex-agent (gated on `should_run == 'true'`, line 1940) never runs. A clean audit leaves the PR held on that head, and a failed audit never starts its next cycle. All three reviewers rated this BLOCKER, with confidence 4-5.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:584-600 (gate env in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml ~654-663; post-sync step at review_autofix.yml:3433-3454) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The clean same-head preconditions have no `post_sync_test_repair` exemption, and the gate step env never receives `POST_SYNC_TEST_REPAIR`.
  WHY: `_dispatch_integration_test_repair` in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh records `integration_test_repair_sha` when it dispatches. If the synchronize run already wrote a clean marker for that head, the repair dispatch is skipped, and the poller's dedupe means it is never re-dispatched, so post-sync test failures are never gated or repaired. All reviewers rated this MAJOR, with confidence 3-5.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:757-762 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The post-marker reviews jq filter drops reviews with `author_type == "Bot"`. The issue requires that any PR review submitted after the marker re-arms the review, with no Bot carve-out.
  WHY: A Bot-submitted review after the clean marker does not re-arm the review, so the gate sets `should_run=false`. The behaviour is pinned by tests/test_review_autofix_clean_same_head_gate.py. Severity disagreement: gemini, luna and glm rated it MAJOR; sonnet and minimax rated it NIT and suggested it may be a deliberate design choice to document in the agents.d fragment.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:357, 653-658, 699-712 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A comment with no `created_at` is projected as `""`, and `sort_key` then orders it before every ISO timestamp. A newer human comment without `created_at` is therefore never counted as newer than the marker (line 701).
  WHY: This breaks the issue's fail-open contract ("any parse error, missing field or failed lookup means do not skip"): the gate can skip as clean_same_head even though it cannot establish comment ordering. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly dismissed this concern because GitHub always returns `created_at`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:612-727 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The embedded Python heredoc parses API-sourced JSON and prints KEY=VALUE lines that the shell re-parses with awk (line 731), which is a new piece of implicit execution.
  WHY: The reviewer found it properly gated: failures fall open to `should_run=true`, and `clean()` sanitises the values. The only concern is readability in a large script, which matches the existing terminal_same_head pattern. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

The security-pass re-dispatch from scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:678-681 (only pr_number) is not handled. No hunk references `single-issue-security-pass`. The security-pass comment posted at review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:672 is dropped by the jq filter at line 357. No env input identifies the follow-up run, and no test in tests/test_review_autofix_clean_same_head_gate.py covers a security-pass follow-up on a marked head.
- requirement: Keep the existing gate contract test green when adding a skip site ("Every skip is logged before the outputs": `GATE_SKIP_RECORDED="true"` count pinned at 3)

  confidence=5

  EVIDENCE: A missing `created_at` is silently coerced to an empty timestamp that sorts as oldest. No code path maps a missing field on a decision-relevant record to outcome=error or a no-skip reason, and no test exercises a comment without `created_at`.

  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_autofix_terminal_same_head_gate.py
